target: Add PATCH /api/decisions/{decision_id}/outcome REST endpoint and update_decision_outcome MCP tool so agents can record retrospective outcomes on existing decisions without touching the immutable summary/rationale fields.
invariants: This packet must not modify the summary or rationale fields of any existing decision.
This packet must preserve the append-only invariant: only outcome_status, outcome_notes, outcome_date, and lessons_learned may be written by the new endpoint.
This packet must not add a new migration if migration 001 already defines the outcome columns; verify before adding SQL.
This packet must fail-closed on unknown decision_id (404) and on attempts to write immutable fields (400).
This packet must classify any unresolved schema ambiguity as UNKNOWN and stop rather than guess.
This packet must not touch files outside the allowlist.
This packet must cite DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-100-migration-foundation-gate proof before relying on migration 001 decision outcome columns.

commit.message: feat(conport): add decision outcome retrospective endpoint and MCP tool

pr.title: feat(conport): decision outcome retrospective endpoint + MCP tool
pr.body: Adds PATCH /api/decisions/{decision_id}/outcome that writes only outcome_status, outcome_notes, outcome_date, and lessons_learned. The summary and rationale fields remain immutable. Adds update_decision_outcome MCP tool in server.py and JSON-RPC handler in conport_mcp_stdio.py. Migration 001 already defines the outcome columns; no new migration is added unless the preflight check finds them absent.

steps.task: Preflight: create a fresh dedicated worktree from origin/main. Verify repo marker (.dopetaskroot), origin identity, branch name, and clean baseline. Read docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/schema.sql and migrations/001*.sql to confirm that outcome_status, outcome_notes, outcome_date, and lessons_learned columns already exist on the decisions table. Record findings in proof.
validation: Worktree path, branch, origin, marker verified and recorded in proof.
Confirmed (or UNKNOWN) whether outcome columns exist in migration 001 — no guessing.
Proof references DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-100-migration-foundation-gate outcome before this packet proceeds.

steps.task: If and only if the preflight in S1 found that outcome columns are absent from the schema, add a new migration file docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/migrations/009_outcome_columns.sql that adds outcome_status (TEXT), outcome_notes (TEXT), outcome_date (TEXT), and lessons_learned (TEXT) to the decisions table. Skip this step entirely if the columns already exist.
validation: Migration file created only when columns were confirmed absent in S1.
Migration is idempotent (uses IF NOT EXISTS or equivalent guard).
If columns already exist, this step is marked NOT_RUN with reason.

steps.task: Write failing tests in docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/tests/test_decision_outcome.py covering: (a) PATCH /api/decisions/{id}/outcome updates outcome fields and returns 200; (b) summary and rationale are unchanged after the PATCH; (c) PATCH on unknown id returns 404; (d) PATCH body containing summary or rationale is rejected with 400.
validation: Tests exist and fail (red) before production code is added.
Test file is self-contained and does not require external services beyond the in-process test client.

steps.task: Implement PATCH /api/decisions/{decision_id}/outcome in enhanced_server.py. Accept a JSON body with only outcome_status, outcome_notes, outcome_date, lessons_learned. Reject (400) any body that includes summary or rationale. Return 404 for unknown decision_id. Use a targeted UPDATE that names each outcome column explicitly — never a wildcard UPDATE.
validation: All four tests from S3 pass (green).
The UPDATE statement names only outcome columns — summary and rationale are not in the SET clause.
No regression in existing enhanced_server.py routes (run full test suite if available).

steps.task: Add update_decision_outcome MCP tool registration in server.py (tool schema: decision_id string required; outcome_status, outcome_notes, outcome_date, lessons_learned all optional strings). Add the JSON-RPC handler in conport_mcp_stdio.py that calls the REST PATCH endpoint or the shared data layer directly, matching the pattern used by existing MCP tools in those files.
validation: update_decision_outcome appears in the MCP tool listing.
JSON-RPC handler routes correctly and returns the updated outcome fields.
Pattern matches existing MCP tool implementations in server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py.

validation: TP JSON validates with exit 0 against dopetask-canonical-spec.json.
